description: A semi-domesticated / semi-wild dairy bovid kept at household scale across the Feywood. Hearthgoats provide milk and cheese; their husbandry is low-intensity and family-scale. Household hearthgoats form genuine personal attachments to keeping families across generations.

ecology.cultural_role: semi-domesticated dairy animal; household-scale husbandry; personal family bonds

name: Hearthgoat
